record.field: Get the migration status of a module for the known migration paths: status (fully_ported, migrate, port_commits, review_migration, replaced, moved_to_standard, moved_to_oca, moved_to_generic), the module it has been renamed to or replaced by, the last scanned commits and the PR url if any.
List the module renames/replacements declared in the database, with their review state: draft timelines are proposals pending review, not applied to the migration analysis yet.
Get the migration scan data of a module for a migration path: the process, the results of the last scan (commits to port, existing PR...) and the last scanned commits.

Declare that a module has been renamed or replaced by another one, starting from the next Odoo version. The 'note' is HTML: start with the confidence tag, then end with a bulleted Source section, one full URL per link (commit first); do not use Markdown. The proposal is created as a draft timeline by default; set 'confirm' to true to create it directly as confirmed (high-confidence proposals only: it immediately impacts the migration analysis). The 'note' should document the sources of truth justifying it (e.g. the GitHub commit URL, the OpenUpgrade migration script URL): a source of truth URL is mandatory to confirm.

Update a draft timeline proposal (new module, type or note). The 'note' is HTML: start with the confidence tag, then end with a bulleted Source section, one full URL per link (commit first); do not use Markdown. Set 'confirm' to true to confirm it once the proposal reaches high confidence (a confirmed timeline immediately impacts the migration analysis, and a source of truth URL is required in 'note'). A confirmed timeline can only have its note updated, and the new note must carry a source URL; semantic fields cannot be modified.
Delete a draft timeline proposal. Confirmed timelines cannot be deleted: they are managed by humans in the UI.

field.name: tool_ids
field.eval: [ (4, ref('migration_get_module_status_tool')), (4, ref('migration_list_timelines_tool')), (4, ref('migration_get_data_tool')), (4, ref('migration_create_timeline_tool')), (4, ref('migration_update_timeline_tool')), (4, ref('migration_delete_timeline_tool')), ]
